reviews.body:
Hey @pcbeingused333,

Thanks for catching this and for the clear write-up in #372. I tested it locally against the live Gemini API:

- On `main`, both `models/embedding-001` and `gemini-1.5-flash` now return 404, so the app was broken at indexing, as you said.
- `models/gemini-3.8-flash` and `models/gemini-embedding-2` are both in the current model list.
- On your branch I uploaded a small test annual report and asked about CEO remuneration and related-party transactions. Indexing with `gemini-embedding-2` worked, and `gemini-3.8-flash` gave a correct, grounded answer.

One heads-up, not blocking: today `gemini-3.8-flash` took about 3 minutes per answer with my key, even for a one-word reply. `gemini-3.5-flash` responded in about 3 seconds. If that persists we may switch the chat model in a follow-up.

Tested locally and it works well. LGTM, approving. Thanks!
